description: Review APIs, frontend pages, and E2E suites. Adds the atomic approveBatch (Finding 6) and getQuestionSources to questionService + their routes, the three lecturer frontend pages (Materials, Generate-with-AI activation on Questions, PendingReview) with their API modules and nav wiring, and the Postgres-backed e2e suites (self-skipping offline). Depends on FEAT-001 (materials API) and FEAT-002 (generation API + question_source_ref). Completes Step 4 and leaves the full suite green.
steps: Add approveBatch({questionIds,rubricId,reviewedBy}) and getQuestionSources(questionId) to backend/src/services/questionService.js. approveBatch [Finding 6]: validate all ids are PENDING_REVIEW and rubricId resolves to a rubric in the subject, then run ONE db.withTransaction(tx=>...) performing set-rubric + assertTransition + updateStatusFields for every id, threading tx to the repo calls; all-or-nothing (any failed transition/rubric check rolls back the whole batch; 409/400 with the offending id). Do NOT loop questionService.approve per item. getQuestionSources -> questionSourceRefRepository.listByQuestionWithMaterial.

Make backend/src/repositories/questionRepository.js updateStatusFields and update accept an optional tx client (default this.db) so approveBatch runs on one transaction client. Inject db into QuestionService's constructor in backend/src/app.js (and pass questionSourceRefRepository).

Wire routes in backend/src/controllers/questionController.js + backend/src/routes/questionRoutes.js: add GET /questions/:id/sources (read guard) and POST /questions/approve-batch (write guard), BOTH registered BEFORE /:id per the existing statics-first convention.

Frontend Materials: backend/.. no -- frontend/src/services/materialApi.js (list via apiRequest; upload via direct fetch with FormData {file,subjectId,topicId?,title?} + credentials:'include' and NO explicit Content-Type; delete via apiRequest). frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Materials.jsx: subject selector, upload control, table (title/type/size/status badge/error text/page-slide count, 'Document' for DOCX null), poll every few seconds while any material is UPLOADED/PROCESSING then stop, delete with confirm surfacing 409 MATERIAL_IN_USE. Topics via existing GET /topics filtered client-side by subject_id. Add route /lecturer/materials in frontend/src/App.jsx and a LECTURER NavLink ('Materials', lucide-react FileText) in frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx.

Frontend Generate-with-AI: frontend/src/services/questionGenerationApi.js (createGenerationJob, getGenerationJob). In frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Questions.jsx enable the disabled Sparkles 'Generate with AI' button (remove disabled title='Available in a future release'), open a Modal with topic select / READY-materials multi-select / count 1-20 / four Bloom inputs with live sum (or distribute-evenly toggle omitting bloomDistribution) / language select; on submit createGenerationJob then poll GET /question-generation-jobs/:id until COMPLETED/FAILED showing generatedCount/requestedCount, refresh the list, map MATERIALS_NOT_READY/BLOOM_SUM_MISMATCH/range errors to inline messages via the thrown error's code.

Frontend Pending-review: frontend/src/services/reviewApi.js wrapping GET /questions?status=PENDING_REVIEW&source=AI, GET /questions/:id/sources, approve/reject/archive, updateQuestion, POST /questions/approve-batch. frontend/src/pages/lecturer/PendingReview.jsx: list of pending AI questions; expand -> left panel (content/bloom/reference/key points/rationale purpose+synthesis), right panel (source chunks: material title, location, excerpt; rationale.warnings.nearDuplicateOf badge). Per-question Approve (rubric picker, reuse RUBRIC_REQUIRED handling), Edit-then-approve, Reject (required reason). Batch approve via checkboxes + a single shared rubric (disabled until a rubric is chosen). Add route /lecturer/pending-review in App.jsx and a LECTURER NavLink ('Pending Review', lucide-react Inbox) in Sidebar.jsx.
Add backend/test/questionReviewService.test.js (approveBatch all-or-nothing rollback when one id is not PENDING_REVIEW; rubric-required; getQuestionSources mapping) using fakes.

Add Postgres-backed e2e suites gated by `const describeDb = process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL ? describe : describe.skip`: backend/test/step4.e2e.test.js (migration 013 applies+backfills; full flow with mock adapters: upload -> ingest -> chunks persisted with non-null subject_id -> generation -> PENDING_REVIEW questions with question_source_ref + generation_job_id set -> findNearestForTopic returns per-material-spread chunks -> approveBatch flips to APPROVED). Add backend/test/materials.e2e.test.js (mock-DB, UNGUARDED like existing *.e2e.test.js) exercising the upload API 201 + enqueued background_job row via supertest. Real Titan/Nova never invoked (env stays mock).
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && npm test` passes including questionReviewService.test.js and all prior suites.
`cd backend && npm run test:e2e` is green offline (step4.e2e self-skips; materials.e2e mock-DB suite passes).
approveBatch rolls back entirely when any id fails its transition or rubric check (asserted), and succeeds all-or-nothing otherwise.
`cd frontend && npm run build` succeeds with the three new/updated pages, their API modules, the two new routes, and the two Sidebar links.
The 'Generate with AI' button is enabled and opens the generation modal (no longer disabled).
findings:
COMPLETED. Step 4 is finished end to end.

[backend: approveBatch — Finding 6] questionService.approveBatch({questionIds,rubricId,reviewedBy}) is atomic/all-or-nothing. It validates the whole batch UP FRONT (every id exists + is PENDING_REVIEW via assertTransition; rubricId resolves via rubricRepository.findById -> 409 RUBRIC_REQUIRED if missing; the rubric's subject_id must match each question's topic.subject_id -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when it differs). Only after all checks pass does it open ONE db.withTransaction(tx => ...) and thread `tx` into questionRepository.updateStatusFields(id, {...}, tx) for every id, so any failure rolls the whole batch back. It does NOT loop questionService.approve. Errors carry err.questionId = the offending id. QuestionService now takes `db` and `questionSourceRefRepository` in its constructor (wired in app.js); questionSourceRefRepository is constructed once near the top of createApp and reused by both QuestionService and the FEAT-002 generation wiring (the duplicate construction in the generation block was removed).

[backend: repo tx threading] questionRepository.update(questionId, patch, client=this.db) and updateStatusFields(questionId, fields, client=this.db) now accept an optional tx client (default this.db) so approveBatch runs every write on the same transaction client.

[backend: getQuestionSources] questionService.getQuestionSources(questionId) 404s on a missing question, else returns questionSourceRefRepository.listByQuestionWithMaterial(questionId) -> [{chunkId, excerpt, materialTitle, location, content}].

[backend: routes] questionController gained approveBatch (reads req.body {questionIds,rubricId}, reviewedBy from req.user) and sources (GET /:id/sources). questionRoutes registers POST /approve-batch (write guard) and GET /:id/sources (read guard) BEFORE the bare /:id routes, per the statics-first convention. POST /questions/approve-batch body { questionIds:[int], rubricId:int } -> 200 [toApiQuestion...]. GET /questions/:id/sources -> 200 [{chunkId,excerpt,materialTitle,location,content}].

[backend: tests] backend/test/questionReviewService.test.js (node --test; matches the *Service.test.js glob so `npm test` runs it) covers approveBatch happy path, all-or-nothing rollback when one id is not PENDING_REVIEW (asserts the untouched row), RUBRIC_REQUIRED, rubric-wrong-subject with offending id, empty-array validation, and getQuestionSources mapping + 404. backend/test/materials.e2e.test.js (mock-DB, supertest, fakes injected via createApp overrides because the InMemoryDatabase has no course_material/background_job SQL) asserts LECTURER upload -> 201 + an INGEST_MATERIAL job enqueued, 401 without a session, and subjectId-missing -> 400 before any write. backend/test/step4.e2e.test.js is gated by `const describeDb = (TEST_DATABASE_URL||DATABASE_URL) ? describe : describe.skip` and drives the REAL SQL flow with mock adapters: migration 013 column+index+backfill; upload (MaterialService, mock S3) -> real INGEST_MATERIAL handler (injected fakeParse so no binary PDF is needed) persists chunks with non-null subject_id; findNearestForTopic spreads across both materials; GENERATE_QUESTIONS handler yields 3 PENDING_REVIEW/AI questions with generation_job_id + >=1 citation; approveBatch flips all to APPROVED and rolls back when one id is not PENDING_REVIEW. Topic name carries a per-run suffix so re-runs are not dropped as exact duplicates.

[frontend: Materials] services/materialApi.js (listMaterials via apiRequest; uploadMaterial via direct fetch + FormData {file,subjectId,topicId?,title?}, credentials:'include', NO explicit Content-Type; deleteMaterial via apiRequest; listTopics). pages/lecturer/Materials.jsx: subject selector (derived from the DISTINCT subject_id values on GET /topics, since there is no lecturer-facing subjects endpoint — labelled 'Subject {id}'), optional topic selector (topics filtered client-side by subject_id), upload button, table (title/type/size/pages-or-slides with 'Document' for DOCX null page_count/status badge/FAILED error text). Polls every 4s while any material is UPLOADED/PROCESSING and stops when all settle. Delete confirms and surfaces 409 MATERIAL_IN_USE. Route /lecturer/materials + a LECTURER 'Materials' NavLink (lucide FileText).

[frontend: Generate with AI] services/questionGenerationApi.js (createGenerationJob, getGenerationJob). pages/lecturer/Questions.jsx: the Sparkles button is ENABLED (the disabled + title='Available in a future release' were removed) and opens a Modal with topic select / READY-materials multi-select / count 1-20 / a 'distribute evenly' toggle (omits bloomDistribution when on) that reveals four Bloom number inputs with a live sum readout when off / language input. On submit it POSTs createGenerationJob then polls getGenerationJob every 2s until COMPLETED/FAILED, shows generatedCount/requestedCount, refreshes the list, and maps MATERIALS_NOT_READY / BLOOM_SUM_MISMATCH / VALIDATION_ERROR / FORBIDDEN to inline messages via the thrown error's code.

[frontend: Pending Review] services/reviewApi.js (listPendingAiQuestions -> GET /questions?status=PENDING_REVIEW&source=AI; getQuestionSources; approve/reject/updateQuestion; approveBatch -> POST /questions/approve-batch). pages/lecturer/PendingReview.jsx: list of pending AI questions with a near-duplicate badge from rationale.warnings.nearDuplicateOf; expand shows a two-panel layout — left: bloom/reference answer/key points/rationale.purpose+synthesis; right: source chunks (materialTitle, location, excerpt). Per-question Approve (rubric picker, reuses RUBRIC_REQUIRED handling), Edit-then-approve (content + reference answer), Reject (prompt reason, required). Batch approve via row checkboxes + a single shared rubric select (Approve-selected disabled until a rubric is chosen); INVALID_TRANSITION is surfaced as 'nothing was changed'. Route /lecturer/pending-review + a LECTURER 'Pending Review' NavLink (lucide Inbox). Rubrics are listed via the existing rubricApi.listRubrics (rows carry {id,maxScore}).

Verification: backend `npm test` 163 pass (incl. questionReviewService.test.js). backend `npm run test:e2e` green offline — 81 pass / 14 skipped (step4.e2e, migrations.e2e, jobQueue.e2e self-skip without a DB; materials.e2e mock-DB passes). Against a real pgvector:pg16 (TEST_DATABASE_URL set) the full e2e suite is 95/95 and idempotent across re-runs. frontend `npm run build` succeeds (2329 modules) with the three pages, three API modules, two routes, two Sidebar links, and the enabled Generate-with-AI modal.

[integration note] The subject selector on Materials/Generate derives subjects from the subject_id on GET /topics because no lecturer-scoped subjects endpoint exists (admin /admin/subjects is ADMIN-only). If a future step adds e.g. GET /subjects/mine, the selectors can switch to real subject code/name labels instead of 'Subject {id}'.
